families.family: Text-labelled links/buttons, resource cards, badges and overview panels
families.required_parts: Text identifies control/category; focus outline where interactive
families.decision: Card/button boundaries and type-chip enclosures are supplementary, not sole control identification. Existing scoped 1.4.3 text assessment retained; focus colours measured here. No blanket requirement for every box border.

families.required_parts: Field boundary on inner/outer surround, focus/error-state boundary
families.decision: Required field location measured in normal, hover, focused and validation-error states. aria-hidden on visual fieldset is not a reason to exclude it; explicit visual sampling added.

families.required_parts: Selected filled background and keyboard focus outline
families.decision: A11Y-07: real .25s colour/background transition delayed selected-fill cue and temporarily reduced text contrast. transition:none makes foreground/background change together. 16 immediate keyboard/pointer changes at 1280/320 meet 3:1 mark and 4.5:1 text.
Accent underline distinguishes location, tested against same dark adjacent background. No requirement to compare current colour to previous time state.

families.required_parts: X icon is sole visible close identifier; focus outline
families.decision: Required icon measured normal, actual hover and keyboard focus at broad/narrow widths; lower bound 3.3923:1. Explicit aria-label does not exempt visual icon.

families.family: Chat launcher, Send, suggestions and next-topic controls
families.required_parts: Visible labels identify labelled controls; icons considered conservatively
families.decision: Glyphs measured even where label repeats function. Inactive controls are excluded only while actually blocked; previously sampled loading/disabled state retained with original date.

families.required_parts: Native triangle position/orientation and focus outline
families.decision: Three source disclosures and six price disclosures tested closed/open; marker colour measured against local background. Six table-region focus outlines tested individually.

families.required_parts: Outer control frame and focus outline; central brand symbol reinforces target
families.decision: Outer .7-alpha frame measured with worst-case halo bounds, paused/running states identified by current UI. Orbital lines/dots are decoration without axes, values or data. No new animation/assistive-technology conformance claim.
SVG brand mark repeats portal identity; no information unique to logo. Source/HTML inventory contains four static SVG shapes plus runtime close icon, not a hidden chart family.

families.family: Tables, callouts, dividers and price-age stripe
families.required_parts: Headers, labels, text and control focus where interactive
families.decision: Separators/shading/stripe reinforce explicit text and spacing, encode no extra values. Age notice explicitly says data are old. No contrast exemption is used for its text.

families.required_parts: Named partners, explicit collaboration introduction, spatial grouping and central team emphasis
families.decision: Central dark ellipse measured conservatively. Seven peripheral outlines/fills are supplementary enclosures: no connecting edges, scales, quantitative values or category legend. Seven names/descriptions remain spatially distinct; introduction states collaboration, green node also says it does not exist. Low outline contrast is recorded but not a breach where enclosure can be omitted without losing content. This visual judgement does not settle alt text/reading order.

families.required_parts: Conservatively measure six icon strokes and twelve list bullets
families.decision: Icon meanings repeated by headings; coloured strips, backgrounds, koalas, row/footer rules and panel borders encode no independent information. All 157 primitives classified with individual reason and bounding box; no classification solely from PDF Figure role/Alt.

note: Reasoned visual information-removal assessment, not an edited-PDF or screen-reader experiment. Text contrast already assessed separately.
